top_news.title: Trump’s Medicaid cuts strip refugees and other legal immigrants of their health coverage - myMotherLode.com
top_news.summary: The Trump administration has cut Medicaid coverage for hundreds of thousands of legal immigrants, including refugees and trafficking victims. The new restrictions took effect at the start of October and aim to reduce federally funded healthcare for noncitizens. Advocates warn that without Medicaid, many people will delay care or rely on emergency rooms, and that will further strain the health system. The administration claims the cuts help ensure immigrants can support themselves without burdening taxpayer-funded programs. For immigrants, the cuts could compound the effects of other administration efforts to restrict their access to public assistance as part of a broader immigration crackdown.

top_news.summary: The Trump administration is pushing forward with a $46 billion border wall from the Pacific Ocean to the Gulf of Mexico.
